lines.text: The Israelites fast in sackcloth with dust on their heads and read the Law for a quarter of the day.
God chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and covenanted to give his descendants the land.
God divided the sea for a dry ground crossing and led them with a pillar of cloud and salt.
God gave them bread from heaven when hungry and water from the river when thirsty.
The people are slaves in the land God gave their fathers, and its harvest goes to their kings.
